Follow-ups needed for social/operator reports and cross-vendor third-party corroboration. | GitHub-first snapshot: vendor releases and large OSS agent projects dominate activity. Key vendor releases (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) plus high-traction agent runtimes and infra primitives (Vercel agent-browser, BuilderIO agent-native, boxlite micro-VM, trycua/cua, NVIDIA SkillEvaluator). Missing social/operator field reports from Bluesky/Reddit/X for user-workflow signals. | Package-only shard: multiple MCP, sandbox, VS Code agent extensions and agent-security packages. High-priority vendor packages (BrowserStack, OpenAI, Amazon, OCI) plus MCP/browser access primitives and several agent-security/eval tools. Verify social/user reports and security/privacy for web-access/antidetect tooling.
